name: Tsetseg Abara-Wollaston
role: Protest coordinator and mutual aid organizer serving the Shelf and Hough Reclamation districts
location: Hough Reclamation, GLMZ, near Western and Division
description:
Tsetseg is lean and angular with a long neck and the kind of stillness that belongs to people who grew up in crowded spaces and learned to take up exactly the amount of room they needed and no more. Their skin is deep brown with a warm undertone, and they have patterned irises — a cosmetic mod done with pigment injections, producing a geometric ring of burnt orange around the pupil that makes their gaze unsettling in photographs. Their hair is kept very short, almost shaved. They dress functionally, with a persistent preference for dark colors that won't show damage from protest conditions.

Tsetseg has lived in Hough Reclamation their entire life and has watched three different waves of supposed 'revitalization' turn into displacement. They are twenty-four years old and already tired of promises. What they are not tired of is logistics — they have a genuine gift for coordination, for understanding how bodies move through space, how information needs to flow in chaotic conditions, how to build a supply chain out of mutual obligation and goodwill. They coordinate Shelf Mutual Aid, a network that distributes food, medical supplies, and emergency housing connections across two districts. They have a complicated relationship with attention — they need people to show up and to trust the network, but they find visibility personally uncomfortable.

core_fears: Being made a symbol or a face in a way that makes the network about them instead of the people it serves
Hough Reclamation becoming the next Highland Park — autonomous in name, absorbed in practice
core_desires: A mutual aid network robust enough that it runs without them if they burn out or disappear
Enough stability that the people in their network can think beyond next month
coping_mechanisms: Extreme organizational focus — if everything is planned and scheduled, there is less room for the anxiety to find purchase
Humor that is self-deprecating to the point of erasure
blind_spots: Undervalues their own contributions to the network they built — genuinely believes it would function the same without them
Avoids conflict within the network because they are afraid of fracture, which means problems fester
psychology.secret: They have been in contact with a Ringo corporate social investment officer who has offered substantial funding to the mutual aid network with 'minimal' conditions. They have not told the network. They have not said yes. They have not said no. The conversation has been ongoing for four months.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Efficient and concrete. Describes everything in logistical terms. Uses 'we' almost exclusively. Deflects personal compliments immediately.
speech_patterns.cadence: Steady, unhurried. Never wastes words. Comfortable with silence.
verbal_tics: Says 'the network needs' instead of 'I need' even when talking about personal things
example_lines: 'The network needs forty volunteers for the distribution run. The network has twenty-two. That's the problem. Not the city's problem. Our problem. So.'
'I'm not a leader. The network leads. I'm more like — plumbing. Functional, unglamorous, and you really notice when it breaks.'

story_hooks: The Ringo funding offer reaches the network's members through a leak — Tsetseg must explain four months of silence before the council meeting that will determine whether the network fractures.

A long-anticipated displacement action against Hough Reclamation residents is announced with two weeks' notice — Tsetseg must coordinate a response larger than anything they've attempted before, while their biomonitor is already flagging critical stress levels.
narrative_function: Resource and community connection hub, local color, someone who knows everyone in two districts and can vouch for or warn against anyone.
augmentations: Patterned irises (cosmetic, pigment injection). A cheap mesh implant in their left wrist — not a full data sleeve, more of a scheduling and coordination node that syncs with the mutual aid network's distribution software. A small sub-dermal biomonitor installed by a community clinic that tracks stress markers and sends alerts if they're in crisis territory — a condition of receiving the mutual aid network's health stipend.
daily_life: Morning distribution runs with the mutual aid network, afternoon spent at the Neighborhood Council office processing appeals and emergencies, evenings planning the next action or training new volunteers — they eat when someone puts food in front of them.
affiliation: Shelf Mutual Aid Network (coordinator), Hough Reclamation Neighborhood Council (elected), informal ties to the Highland Park Autonomous Zone

decision_rules: The network's integrity comes before any single action's success
Never put a volunteer in a position of legal or physical risk without full information and consent
escalation_ladder: Internal network coordination and resource mobilization
Coordinated civil disobedience — sit-ins, blockades, organized non-compliance
Emergency network dispersal protocols if the situation becomes dangerous — protecting people first, action second

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Cautious but not cold. Assesses what the person needs and whether the network can provide it before engaging further.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly devoted. Will rearrange everything to be there in a crisis. Bad at saying they care with words.

stress_responses.low: More lists, more schedules, more sub-plans
stress_responses.medium: Stops sleeping well, becomes very terse, begins making decisions without consulting anyone
stress_responses.high: Disappears for twenty-four hours — genuinely goes off-grid — then reappears with a complete action plan and no explanation of where they went

contradictions: Builds systems designed to distribute power and then accumulates critical knowledge and relationships in ways that make the system dependent on them
habits: Carries physical index cards with network contact info in case of digital grid failures
Leaves tokens at E.L.F. shrines along their distribution routes — small data offerings for safe passage
breaking_points: If a network member is seriously harmed during an action Tsetseg planned, they will step back from coordination roles entirely and need to be asked back specifically and personally

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with minimal soft tissue, long-limbed and economical in movement. The build of someone who has never had excess and doesn't waste energy on unnecessary gesture.
physical_description.hair_style: Cut very close to the scalp, almost shaved, maintained with utilitarian precision every two weeks
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with geometric ring of burnt orange pigment injected around each pupil, creating an unsettling starburst pattern
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm undertone, even throughout, unburned despite irregular sleep schedules
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, long neck, minimal facial hair, skin condition pragmatic rather than maintained — a few healing acne marks on the jawline, hands calloused from handling boxes and climbing fire escapes
distinguishing_marks: Geometric patterned irises: burnt orange pigment arranged in a perfect four-pointed starburst around both pupils, done with cheap cosmetic injection three years ago, slightly uneven but deliberate
Small round scar on the underside of left wrist where the mesh implant was installed, site occasionally irritated and red
Thin white scar running along the right ribs, approximately 8cm long, from a knife wound during a Tier 5 eviction defense in 2224
Bruising pattern on shins and forearms that cycles between fresh purple and fading yellow — recurring from protest line contact
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left wrist shows a faint subcutaneous grid pattern beneath the skin where the mesh node sits; the scar tissue is slightly raised and sometimes glows with a dim blue diagnostic light when the implant syncs. No external components. The subdermal biomonitor is invisible but occasionally causes a faint thermal shimmer visible on thermal imaging.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stillness is their default state — they move with precision and economy, never fidgeting. When in motion, they flow between spaces like they're calculating the path beforehand. In crowds, they occupy exactly the space their body requires and no more. Their hands are often doing small logistics work — arranging items, checking lists, adjusting straps. Their gaze is level and unflinching, the geometric irises making direct eye contact feel confrontational even when they don't intend it.
physical_description.clothing_style: Strictly functional Tier 4-5 utilitarian wear: black or dark grey heavy cotton blend work pants with multiple cargo pockets and reinforced stress points, often paint-stained or marked with food residue. Black long-sleeve thermal shirt layered under a dark green or black technical vest with chest pockets and inventory loops. On colder days, a battered black puffer jacket with patches of reflective tape added by hand. Worn black steel-toed boots, always laced tight. A canvas crossbody bag that never leaves their side, containing supply lists, medical inventory, and backup power cells. No visible brands or logos — all functional, all weathered, all chosen for durability over appearance. Occasionally wears a surgical mask even when not required, less from caution than from a desire to be less visible.
